title_en: CORONA — PARKER SOLAR PROBE & SOLAR ORBITER
title_ru: КОРОНА — PARKER SOLAR PROBE И SOLAR ORBITER
description: An interactive field guide to flying to the Sun: why it takes more energy to reach the Sun than to leave the Solar System, Helios's 1970s records, Parker Solar Probe's heat shield and its record 6.16 million km pass at 192 km/s, the first flight through the corona in 2021, and Solar Orbiter's first views of the Sun's poles.
og: The Δv to fall into the Sun, the temperature of a sunlit shield, and the speed of the fastest object ever built — Parker Solar Probe and Solar Orbiter, interactive and sourced.
brand: CORONA — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
